definitions.explanation: A person who was exposed to the atomic bombings of Hiroshima or Nagasaki in 1945 and survived. Under Japanese law the term also covers people who entered the cities soon afterwards and children then in the womb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{被爆者|ひばくしゃ}だ。
examples.english: My grandmother is an atomic-bomb survivor.

examples.japanese: {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: We heard a hibakusha's story at school.

examples.japanese: {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均年齢|へいきんねんれい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八十五歳|はちじゅうごさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}え→超える：01942_koeru⟧、⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}れる→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The average age of the hibakusha is over eighty-five, and fewer and fewer can tell of their experience.

notes:
⟦{被爆|ひばく}→被爆：31751_hibaku⟧ (being hit by a bomb) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The word has passed into English as hibakusha.

WRITING:
⟦{被爆|ひばく}→被爆：31751_hibaku⟧ (with {爆|ばく}, bomb) is exposure to a bombing; ⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧ (with {曝|ばく}, exposure) is exposure to radiation from any source, such as a nuclear accident. Survivors of Hiroshima and Nagasaki are {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}; people exposed at Fukushima are ⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被爆者健康手帳|ひばくしゃけんこうてちょう}: the health handbook that entitles survivors to free medical care
- {被爆者|ひばくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧: a survivor's testimony
- ⟦{被爆|ひばく}→被爆：31751_hibaku⟧{二世|にせい}: child of an atomic-bomb survivor
